application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.value: DTI: NMC-class; QAS: LFP; GIS: unknown
chemistry.source: fielddata/specs.py cao groups (cell-voltage range rule over released vin_2 cell voltages)
chemistry.note: Inferred from measured cell-voltage ranges; the Zenodo record, released archives, and paper do not name the chemistry.

cells_liion.source: DTI vehicles x 85 plus QAS vehicles x 110; GIS excluded because its channel meaning is unresolved

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.source: DTI vehicles x 85 plus QAS vehicles x 110; GIS excluded because its channel meaning is unresolved

energy_mwh.source: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-56832-8, Supplementary Information, Note S5, p. 24 (one frame every 30 s)
energy_mwh.note: Estimate by coulomb counting at the stated 30 s spacing, times mean pack voltage (sum of series cell voltages): DTI 44.7 kWh per vehicle (median of 73 of 80 vehicles with a usable charge or discharge of at least 20 percent SOC), times 80 vehicles; QAS 29.3 kWh per vehicle (median of 393 of 393 vehicles with a usable charge or discharge of at least 20 percent SOC), times 393 vehicles. GIS (41 vehicles) excluded because its channel layout is unresolved. Present usable energy, not the nameplate rating.

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from the released data

obs_hours.source: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-56832-8, Supplementary Information, Note S5, p. 24 (one frame every 30 s)
obs_hours.note: All released rows (DTI, QAS and GIS) times the stated 30 s frame spacing; the release itself has no timestamps.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10656500; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
